methodology: Signals scored 1–10 on Importance (strategic weight), Confidence (source quality), Cloudbound Impact (relevance to AHRA/concept/operation), and Time Sensitivity (decay rate of action window). Composite = (Importance + Impact) × Confidence / 10. Cloudbound recommendation: organize the system around signals (concept / demand / capital / expansion / talent / marketing), not companies.

signals.headline: Launch Entertainment (Silver Oak PE) now 30 units; signed Arlington TX (opened May 1 2026), Pensacola FL (Sept 2026), Centennial CO (early 2027); explicitly targeting mom-and-pop FEC roll-ups.
signals.time_sensitivity: high — roll-up window is live; targets are the same single-unit operators in Cloudbound tracker
signals.cloudbound_action: Build a counter-roll-up thesis or sell-side narrative now. Launch is buying the exact small-operator cohort in tracker rows 40–205. Cloudbound must decide: compete as buyer, or pre-empt Launch on premium-format anchors.

signals.headline: Five Star Parks & Attractions (Court Square Capital Partners / Fruition / Taubman) at 25 FECs in 12 states; acquired Scene75 (5 units), Malibu Jack's (3 KY units), Dubby's (5 MO/TN units), Celebration Station (5 units).
signals.time_sensitivity: medium — already deployed; next acquisitions likely Q3-Q4 2026
signals.cloudbound_action: Map Five Star's deal cadence vs. tracker — they will likely scoop 1–2 of our tracker targets before EOY. Identify which tracker companies overlap their geography (OH, MO, KY, TN) and flag.

signals.headline: Kids Empire crossed 100 units (tracker says 68). Q2 2026 openings: Escondido CA, North Bergen NJ, Milwaukee Bayshore. Franchise CAPEX $803K–$1.77M (large-format 15K sqft).
signals.time_sensitivity: high — pace of opening is ~1 unit / 2 weeks
signals.cloudbound_action: Update tracker: Kids Empire location count is materially understated (68 → 100+). They are the #1 direct format competitor. Pull their full store locator + permit watch on next 5 leases. Decide if Cloudbound enters head-to-head in any of their target trade areas (Phoenix, Dallas-Frisco, NJ).

signals.headline: CAMP partnered with Simon Property Group on 2 new flagships (King of Prussia, Houston Galleria); 60%+ of revenue now from entertainment/tickets (was retail-led); raised $17M July 2025; cumulative funding $31M–$154M depending on source.
signals.time_sensitivity: medium — pattern is replicable; Simon partnership template is public
signals.cloudbound_action: Use CAMP/Simon as the template for Cloudbound's mall-anchor pitch. Simon will entertain a category-defining play tenant. Their model proves the entertainment-flip works in retail real estate.

signals.headline: New format emerging: play space + parent coworking lounge. Tiny's Corner (Tysons Corner mall, fall 2026, ~3,000 sqft), Think Lounge (Austin, on-site screen-free childcare), Little's Loft (Kirkwood MO, programming-heavy), Mulberry Lane variants in Northern VA.
signals.time_sensitivity: medium — format is converging now; first-mover at scale wins narrative
signals.cloudbound_action: Cloudbound can absorb this format as a 'parent floor' module rather than ceding it. Validate via lease economics — these are small (3K sqft) and high-margin per visit. If Cloudbound adds a parent coworking deck to its flagship, it captures the dual-occupant pricing power.

signals.headline: Primrose Schools acquired by Taurus Capital Partners; 500+ schools. PE-backed preschool consolidation continues (Goddard, Kiddie Academy, KinderCare, Learning Experience all PE-touched). Endeavor Schools has exited PE.
signals.time_sensitivity: low — informational; bears on Cloudbound's adjacency strategy
signals.cloudbound_action: Add preschool/childcare to the master tracker as a new category. PE-backed preschools could be a Cloudbound JV channel (after-school programming, weekend events). Map overlap geography.

signals.headline: Platinum Equity-owned PlayPower acquiring BCI Burke (commercial playground equipment) — Q2 2026 close. Supply-side consolidation; pricing leverage moves to buyer.
signals.time_sensitivity: medium — closes Q2 2026; sourcing implications in H2
signals.cloudbound_action: If Cloudbound is committing to equipment specs in next 90 days, lock pricing before close. Identify secondary suppliers (KoalaPlay, Dreamland, Hanlin, Iplayco) for negotiating leverage.

signals.headline: Industry-wide pivot to membership/MRR ('gym model'); membership +18% revenue lift; responsive/dynamic pricing replacing flat hourly; short-term memberships for life-transition families (new baby, therapy, school change).
signals.time_sensitivity: high — table stakes by EOY 2026; differentiator window is closing
signals.cloudbound_action: Cloudbound's pricing architecture should ship at launch with: (1) tiered membership w/ MRR, (2) life-transition short-term passes, (3) dynamic peak/off-peak. NOT a differentiator anymore — a baseline. Differentiate above this layer.

signals.headline: Edutainment segment $2B with 25% CAGR target by 2030. Parents increasingly require academic value alongside play. Cuemath secured $20M extension (10 languages). Disney/Universal/Merlin lead, but VC chasing skill-based hybrids.
signals.cloudbound_action: Cloudbound positioning copy must lead with developmental/educational outcomes, not just 'fun.' Build a STEM/literacy partnership at flagship (museums, Montessori, library systems) to lock the premium frame.

signals.headline: Uptown Jungle expanding across AZ/NV/CA/UT (~10 units); new North Phoenix unit opened. Hybrid trampoline + toddler + ball blaster format competing in same trade areas as Kids Empire.
signals.cloudbound_action: If Cloudbound's first site is in the Mountain West (AZ/NV/UT), it will share customers with Uptown Jungle. Audit their pricing, party packages, and Instagram engagement.

signals.headline: Cheeky Monkeys grew 200% over 3 years to 9 US units (Dallas, Houston base); targeting FL via National Franchise Show Tampa. $40K franchise fee, $598K–$1.2M total CAPEX, 6% royalty.
signals.cloudbound_action: Watch as a franchise economics benchmark — their CAPEX and royalty band are reference for Cloudbound's franchise FDD math.

signals.headline: IAAPA Expo 2026 Nov 16–20 in Orlando — nearly 50% larger than 2025 (record-breaking). FEC Summit 2026 already concluded Feb 1–3 in Glendale AZ.
signals.time_sensitivity: medium — 5 months out, plan attendance + meetings now
signals.cloudbound_action: Reserve booth or executive meeting suite at IAAPA Expo Nov 2026. This is where Five Star, Launch, PE buyers, and equipment OEMs all converge. Single best concentrated diligence + sourcing event of the year.

signals.headline: KidZania still has 1 US location (Frisco TX) vs. 28 globally; no announced US expansion. Premier global edutainment brand has not cracked US scale despite 100K sqft Dallas flagship since 2021.
signals.time_sensitivity: low — opportunity to claim the role-play edutainment narrative in US
signals.cloudbound_action: If Cloudbound wants the 'role-play city' narrative slot, the door is open. KidZania has not scaled US in 5 years. Either acquire/license the format, or build a homegrown variant before someone else does.

signals.headline: Indoor playground social engagement skews to short-form: obstacle runs, climbing 'playground hacks,' group-tag variations, UGC reposted by venues. Visually dynamic + easy-to-replicate clips outperform branded content.
signals.cloudbound_action: Cloudbound launch playbook: every attraction designed with a 'TikTok shot' built in (a hook camera angle, a wow moment under 10 sec). UGC reposting program from day 1. Bake the content engine into the venue architecture.
